initial_suite.scope: Daily update/cache/lock and original HTTP caller with a mocked preflight-failure assertion.

strengthened_cli_failure_case.scope: Actual CLI subprocess with failing fake maintenance command; no local mock model POST.

final_suite_after_user_recovery_correcti.scope: All maintenance tools and AI handlers mocked. Attached AI repair then real recheck; command-driver repair then exactly one mock model POST; claimed repair without actual recovery remains an AI handoff.

repair_driver_recursion_guard.scope: After adding child-driver environment isolation, reran only the affected repair-driver integration case; exactly one model mock POST after recovery.

recovery_contract.behavior: Maintenance failure goes to hosting AI diagnosis and repair, then an actual daily recheck, then the original pending task.
recovery_contract.bootstrap: The hosting AI may use its existing model/tools to repair maintenance without first passing the OpenCode version gate.
recovery_contract.command_driver: LOCAL_MODEL_AI_REPAIR_COMMAND is a JSON argv array; recovery JSON is supplied on stdin.
recovery_contract.unattached_handler: CLI exit 75 and AI_REPAIR_REQUIRED delegate continued repair to the hosting AI; not a terminal business-task result.
recovery_contract.proof_requirement: A driver success claim alone never marks the day ready.

source_hash_scope: Hashes bind Windows working-file bytes at sealing after recovery-contract refinements, not normalized Git blobs or dispatch-time attestation of the earlier live-update helper.
private_evidence: User-state daily cache and command journals, original update result, independent CLI cache result, and diagnostic/repair tasks remain on the execution machine.
public_exclusions: Absolute paths, machine/user identity, raw package-manager logs, model prompts/responses, credentials and environment contents.
limits: Real update and cache verification are Windows-only.
Concurrent-client test used two threads with the native file lock; no multi-host test.
Actual AI diagnosis was not exercised because the real update succeeded; AI repair orchestration used test handlers.
CLI upgrade does not establish OpenCode 1.19.5 native-tool or business correctness.
Independent consuming clients must sync the shared policy and bind the check/AI recovery contract; their rollout was not performed here.
